stem:
Enzymes are proteins that have a three-dimensional shape that is specific to a particular substrate. Environmental conditions can change the shape of the protein.

What is the most likely result if the shape of the enzyme changes?

options.label: F
options.text: The substrate will change its shape to match the enzyme.

options.label: G
options.text: The enzyme will no longer be able to catalyze the reaction with the substrate.

options.label: H
options.text: The products made from the enzyme and the substrate will be changed.

options.label: J
options.text: The enzyme will be able to bind to more diverse substrates than before.
